blind_spots_patched: ch-3 named the three U.S. wholesalers (McKesson, Cardinal Health, Cencora) but omitted the FY2025 Form 10-K disclosure that a single wholesaler can account for up to 43% of AbbVie's U.S. gross revenues, as well as single-source third-party supplier exposure for certain APIs, fill-finish, and device components.

ch-6 and ch-5 omitted Q3 2026 post-Apogee balance-sheet figures ($80,903M total debt, $70,129M net debt, -$4,583M stockholders' deficit, $1,503M 9M 2026 buybacks, $1.3B litigation accrual) and Note 7's $27,312M contingent consideration liability schedule.

ch-3 misattributed FY2025 contingent consideration payouts ($2,865M) to Allergan/M&A and omitted 9M 2026 working-capital friction (-$2,934M, including -$2,003M net tax payments) and +28.0% YoY growth in contingent consideration cash payouts ($2,796M in 9M 2026).

ch-4 missed the October 29, 2026 D.C. District Court ruling vacating CMS's Round 3 IRA selection of Botox, and omitted AbbVie's $19,568M FX forward hedge book ($14,505M Euro) and $2.0B 10%-appreciation sensitivity.

ch-5 did not audit AbbVie's 2026 DEF 14A executive incentive metrics (40% LTI in 3-year Relative ROIC; Adjusted ROA in annual bonus; zero explicit net-leverage gate) or Q4 2026 Form 4/8-K board & insider updates.
assumptions_changed: CONFIRMED: 9M 2026 net revenues reached $49,396M (+10.9% YoY), led by Skyrizi ($15,764M, +25.6% YoY), Rinvoq ($7,350M, +23.9% YoY), and Neuroscience ($9,492M, +21.6% YoY).
CONFIRMED: FY2025 unit economics waterfall converts $61,160M net revenues into $19,030M CFO and $17,816M FCF with zero D&A double-counting, and 9M 2026 cash conversion remains ~28%+ FCF margin.
WEAKENED: CMS selected Botox and Botox Cosmetic for Round 3 Medicare IRA price negotiation in January 2026, creating a 2028 statutory pricing headwind.
CONFIRMED: Management raised FY2026 guidance across three quarters and increased the quarterly dividend by 5.2% to $1.82/share starting February 2027.
